title: Entergy Solutions programs are now available
summary: This year, Entergy is proud to launch several new energy efficiency programs that offer a variety of energy efficiency services, including expert guidance, home and building assessments…
body_markdown:
Entergy Louisiana is making it easier for customers to save energy, lower costs, and improve comfort. No matter what your needs are, there is a new opportunity to save energy and make your home or business more efficient. This year, Entergy is proud to launch several new energy efficiency programs that offer a variety of energy efficiency services, including expert guidance, home and building assessments, energy-saving products and more. Visit **Entergy Solutions by Entergy Louisiana** for more program details and learn how Entergy Louisiana can help you start saving today.


**Home Performance Solutions**


Get a home energy assessment from an authorized trade ally. Entergy Louisiana’s no-cost home energy assessments are available to all qualifying residential customers. Learn more about your home’s energy use and get recommendations on improvements that make sense for you and your family. Schedule your home energy assessment today, visit our **Home Performance Solutions** page **.**


**Income-Qualified Solutions**


Your eligible single-family home, manufactured home, or multifamily properties may qualify for no-cost energy-saving upgrades through the Income Qualified Solutions program. Available upgrades include A/C tune-ups, ceiling insulation, water-saving measures, and more. Schedule a no-cost home energy assessment to get started, visit our **Income** **-Qualified Solutions** page.


**Manufactured Homes Solutions**


Did you know that most manufactured homes struggle to maintain temperature due to leaky ductwork. Get tips and recommendations on ways to save energy. Schedule an assessment today and see if you qualify for no-cost upgrades. Schedule a no-cost home energy assessment to get started, visit our **Manufactured Homes Solutions** page.


**Multifamily Solutions**


Upgrades are also available for eligible multifamily units and common areas. The Entergy Louisiana Multifamily Solutions program helps property owners and tenants get access to low-cost and no-cost services like A/C tune-ups and smart thermostats. Schedule a no-cost home energy assessment to get started, visit our **Multifamily Solutions** page.


**Large Commercial & Industrial Solutions**


Organizations with a monthly demand greater than 100 kW may qualify for incentives through the Entergy Louisiana Large Commercial & Industrial Solutions program. Available solutions support commercial, industrial, higher education, and agricultural customers looking to improve energy efficiency through equipment upgrades, retrofits, and new construction projects. Our account managers can help identify opportunities, estimate savings, and determine available incentives. Submit an application to get started on our **Large Commercial & Industrial Solutions** page **.**


**Small Commercial Solutions**


Small businesses may qualify for incentives through the Entergy Louisiana Small Commercial Solutions program. Available upgrades can help reduce energy use, lower operating costs and improve business comfort through options like HVAC tune-ups, LED lighting, smart thermostats and other eligible equipment. A trade ally can walk you through recommended upgrades, potential savings and incentive options. Be among the first to know. Contact us and receive updates when the **Small Commercial Solutions** program launches in October.
